::: {#exr-office-cables}
#### Computers and cables

An office has six computers, named $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $e$ and $f$.
A cable joins the two computers in each of these eight pairs:

$$
\set{a, b}, \set{a, c}, \set{b, c}, \set{b, d}, \set{c, e}, \set{d, e}, \set{d, f}, \set{e, f}.
$$

Draw a point for each computer and a line for each cable.
How many cables have computer $d$ at one end?

:::
